title: Diagnose AGV exchange/backfill gap when an AGV moves out without a replacement

This candidate turns that into a live diagnostic check using RMS and/or WCS/Helix DB to confirm trailing AGV fault/backfill behavior and whether exchange timing/chute fullness conditions are present.
rough_steps: Open RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) and locate the AGV pair involved in the exchange event (the AGV that moved out and the AGV that should have backfilled). [Image support needed: RMS UI screen showing AGV status/error fields and fleet/roster context.]

[Image support needed: SSMS query results grid showing AGV state/error rows for the time window.]

Check whether chute closure/fullness conditions could have occurred by reviewing live system data available via WCS/Helix DB (wcs_sql) for chute fullness / exchange timing metrics around the event; look for conditions consistent with “chute gets closed when the chute is full” and exchange not completing before the 80% threshold. failure_or_escalation_notes: Escalate if RMS and WCS/Helix DB do not show a trailing AGV fault/backfill failure and chute fullness/exchange timing metrics do not align with the segment’s described mechanisms.
Do not assume the cause solely from the event description; require live fault/state evidence for the trailing AGV and/or live chute fullness/exchange timing evidence.
